title: E. Howard Hunt's Everglades group burned out by marshals

tellings.quote: Then a second group, the ones in the Everglades, the under the leazison of E Howard Hunt.

plain: In 1963, a group based in the Florida Everglades, which worked with the CIA officer E. Howard Hunt as its go-between, was burned out of its camp by federal marshals. That is what the researcher Dan Sheehan tells Michels, calling it "a second group, the ones in the Everglades," in an account that also involves Robert F. Kennedy. He gives no source for it. It is one piece of a larger story Sheehan tells about the Kennedy years and what he says the government was hiding.
